source: symfony/intl v7.4.8 7cfb7792d580, as langsys2 d55f0ca9 locks it: Resources/data/currencies/*.php and Resources/data/locales/meta.php
description: What Currencies::getName reads: each locale with a currency bundle, matched case-sensitively as on a Linux host, and the currencies its bundle names (a small bundle by the codes it holds, a large one by the codes of all_currencies it lacks); and the locale aliases resolved at each step. The root bundle names a currency by its code. Re-vendor from symfony/intl on a deliberate bump, never by hand.
